title: Augmented simplicial object of a counital coassociative endofunctor
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an ordinary category, $T:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ an endofunctor, and $e:T\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ and $c:T\to T^2$ natural transformations satisfying $(eT)\circ c=1_T=(Te)\circ c$ and $(cT)\circ c=(Tc)\circ c$. For $n\geq0$ set $B_n=T^{n+1}$, with $T^0=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$. The natural transformations $d_i=T^i e T^{n-i}:B_n\to B_{n-1}$ for $n\geq1$, $0\leq i\leq n$, and $s_i=T^i c T^{n-i}:B_n\to B_{n+1}$ for $0\leq i\leq n$, make $B_\bullet$ a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] in the category of endofunctors of $\mathcal C$. The map $e:B_0\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ extends to an augmentation $B_\bullet\to\operatorname{const}(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C})$. In particular evaluation at $x\in\mathcal C$ gives an augmented simplicial object, naturally in $x$.

source.place: Tag 0G5N, lemma-godement, with the construction in Example 0G5M (example-godement).

proof.text: Take the degree objects $B_n=T^{n+1}$ and the natural transformations specified in the statement. Apply [lem-trf-comonad-face-identities] with this $T,e$. It supplies the face--face relation for every $n\geq1$ and $0\leq i<j\leq n+1$, including adjacent indices; it needs no hypothesis on $c$.

source.place: Tag 0G5N, lemma-godement, assembly from operator identities and counit augmentation; Tag 016B, lemma-characterize-simplicial-object.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-comonad-mixed-degeneracy-identities] to the given $T,e,c$. Its hypotheses are exactly the two counit equations and coassociativity assumed here. It supplies both non-overlapping mixed relations, the two overlapping mixed identities, and the degeneracy--degeneracy relation, including degree zero. Thus all five relations required in [lem-trf-simplicial-operators-reconstruction] hold for the prescribed operators.

source.place: Tag 0G5N, lemma-godement, assembly from operator identities and counit augmentation; Tag 016B, lemma-characterize-simplicial-object.

proof.text: Use the object reconstruction clause of [lem-trf-simplicial-operators-reconstruction] in $\mathcal D=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal C,\mathcal C)$. Steps 1--2 verify its five relations, so it constructs a simplicial object with exactly the specified degree objects, faces and degeneracies. Take endofunctors in a containing universe; no limits, colimits or smallness of $\mathcal C$ are required.

source.place: Tag 0G5N, lemma-godement, assembly from operator identities and counit augmentation; Tag 016B, lemma-characterize-simplicial-object.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-comonad-counit-augmentation] to the simplicial object just constructed. Its one counit hypothesis is among our assumptions, and its operator hypotheses are the exact operators supplied in step 3. Its horizontal counit words give the augmentation with degree-zero component $e$; its evaluation functor has terms $T^{n+1}(x)$ and maps $T^{n+1}(f)$ and therefore proves the required naturality in $x$.

source.place: Tag 0G5N, lemma-godement, assembly from operator identities and counit augmentation; Tag 016B, lemma-characterize-simplicial-object.

lean.statement: theorem comonad_simplicial_object {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (T : C ⥤ C) (e : T ⟶ 𝟭 C) (c : T ⟶ T ⋙ T) (h₁ : c ≫ Functor.whiskerRight e T ≫ (Functor.leftUnitor T).hom = 𝟙 T) (h₂ : c ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft T e ≫ (Functor.rightUnitor T).hom = 𝟙 T) (h₃ : c ≫ Functor.whiskerRight c T ≫ (Functor.associator T T T).hom = c ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft T c) : ∃ (B : SimplicialObject (C ⥤ C)) (α : B ⟶ (SimplicialObject.const (C ⥤ C)).obj (𝟭 C)), (∀ n : ℕ, B.obj (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk n)) = NaturalTransport.power T (n + 1)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)), HEq (B.δ i) (Functor.whiskerLeft (NaturalTransport.power T (n + 1 - i.val)) (Functor.whiskerRight e (NaturalTransport.power T i.val)))) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)), HEq (B.σ i) (Functor.whiskerLeft (NaturalTransport.power T (n - i.val)) (Functor.whiskerRight c (NaturalTransport.power T i.val)))) ∧ HEq (α.app (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0))) e ∧ ∃ E : C ⥤ SimplicialObject.Augmented C, E ⋙ SimplicialObject.Augmented.drop = B.flip ∧ E ⋙ SimplicialObject.Augmented.point = 𝟭 C ∧ ∀ (x : C) (n : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ), HEq ((E.obj x).hom.app n) ((α.app n).app x)
lean.note: Reuses CategoryTheory.NaturalTransport.power through definition node def-trf-endofunctor-powers. HEq specifies the literal whiskered operators across equal parenthesized power functors; it is equality, not an arbitrary comparison isomorphism. Evaluation is a functor to Mathlib augmented simplicial objects.
